Each Jump Pack, Wulfen, or Terminator model takes the space of 2 other Infantry models, and each Centurion model takes the space of 3 other Infantry models. It cannot transport Primaris units.

infernum-pattern-razorback.transport: This unit can transport up to 6 friendly DARK ANGELS INFANTRY models. It cannot transport TERMINATOR, JUMP PACK, CENTURION or PRIMARIS models.

relic-land-raider-proteus.transport: This unit can transport up to 10 friendly DARK ANGELS INFANTRY models. TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK models take up the space of 2 other models and each CENTURION model takes up the space of 3 other models. It cannot transport PRIMARIS models.

land-raider-helios.name: Land Raider Helios
land-raider-helios.transport: This unit can transport up to 6 friendly DARK ANGELS INFANTRY models. TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK models take up the space of 2 other models and each CENTURION model takes up the space of 3 other models. It cannot transport PRIMARIS models.

terrax-pattern-termite-assault-drill.name: Terrax-pattern Termite Assault Drill
terrax-pattern-termite-assault-drill.transport: This unit can transport up to 12 friendly DARK ANGELS INFANTRY models. It cannot transport JUMP PACK, TERMINATOR or PRIMARIS  models.

land-raider-prometheus.transport: This unit can transport up to 10 friendly DARK ANGELS INFANTRY models. TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK models take up the space of 2 other models and each CENTURION model takes up the space of 3 other models. It cannot transport PRIMARIS models.

land-raider-achilles.name: Land Raider Achilles
land-raider-achilles.transport: This unit can transport up to 6 friendly Dark Angels INFANTRY models. TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK models take up the space of 2 other models and each CENTURION model takes up the space of 3 other models. It cannot transport PRIMARIS models.

relic-spartan-assault-tank.name: Relic Spartan Assault Tank
relic-spartan-assault-tank.transport: This unit can transport up to 25 friendly DARK ANGELS INFANTRY models. TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK models take up the space of 2 other models and each CENTURION model takes up the space of 3 other models. It cannot transport PRIMARIS models.

relic-mastodon-super-heavy-siege-transpo.name: Relic Mastodon Super-heavy Siege Transport
relic-mastodon-super-heavy-siege-transpo.transport:
This unit can transport friendly DARK ANGELS  models in one of the following combinations:
-- Up to 40 INFANTRY models.
-- Up to 30 INFANTRY models and 1 Dreadnought model.
-- Up to 20 INFANTRY models and up to 2 Dreadnought models.
Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes the space of 2 other INFANTRY models and each CENTURION model takes the space of 3 other INFANTRY models. It cannot transport PRIMARIS models.

impulsor.name: Impulsor
impulsor.transport: This unit can transport up to 6 friendly DARK ANGELS PRIMARIS INFANTRY models. It cannot transport JUMP PACK or MK X GRAVIS units.

enmitys-edge.name: Enmity's Edge
enmitys-edge.text: If a wound roll for an attack made with this weapon is successful, and the target is a PSYKER, place two blast markers next to the target unit instead of one.

blessing-of-the-omnissiah.name: Blessing of the Omnissiah
blessing-of-the-omnissiah.text: At the end of the Action phase, this unit can attempt to repair one friendly DARK ANGELS Vehicle unit in base contact with it. If it does, roll one D6; on a 4+ remove one damage marker from that Vehicle unit. Only one attempt to repair each unit can be made each turn.

data-augurs.name: Data Augurs
data-augurs.text: Change this unit’s Ballistic Skill characteristic to 2+ whilst it is within 6" of any friendly DARK ANGELS RHINO PRIMARIS units.

servo-skull-hub.name: Servo-skull Hub
servo-skull-hub.text: At the start of the Damage phase, you can remove one small blast marker from one friendly DARK ANGELS Vehicle unit within 6" of this unit.

the-lion-helm.name: The Lion Helm
the-lion-helm.text: Improve the Save characteristic (to a maximum of 4+) of friendly LIGHT DARK ANGELS units by 1 whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

chapter-master.name: Chapter Master
chapter-master.text: You can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made by friendly DARK ANGELS units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

supreme-tactician.name: Supreme Tactician
supreme-tactician.text: Roll one D6 if this unit is on the battlefield at the start of the Orders phase, or is embarked aboard a Transport that is on the battlefield at the start of the Orders phase. On a 4+ you can generate one extra Command Asset.

grand-master-of-the-deathwing.name: Grand Master of the Deathwing
grand-master-of-the-deathwing.text: You can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made by friendly Deathwingunits whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

grand-master-of-the-ravenwing.name: Grand Master of the Ravenwing
grand-master-of-the-ravenwing.text: You can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made by friendly Ravenwing units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

exemplar-of-hate.name: Exemplar of Hate
exemplar-of-hate.text: You can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by friendly DARK ANGELS units whilst they are within 6" of this unit. In addition, improve the Attacks characteristic of friendly LIGHT DARK ANGELS units by 1 whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

book-of-salvation.name: Book of Salvation
book-of-salvation.text: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by friendly LIGHT DARK ANGELS units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

deathwing-company-banner.name: Deathwing Company Banner
deathwing-company-banner.text: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of Deathwing units when making Fight actions whilst they are within 6" of any friendly units with this ability.

ravenwing-banner.name: Ravenwing Banner
ravenwing-banner.text: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of Ravenwing units when making Fight actions whilst they are within 6" of any friendly units with this ability.

icon-of-old-caliban.name: Icon of Old Caliban
icon-of-old-caliban.text: Icon of Old Caliban: Friendly DARK ANGELS LIGHT and DARK ANGELS HEAVY units have the Stealth ability whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

ravenwing-land-speeder-vengeance.name: Ravenwing Land Speeder Vengeance
ravenwing-land-speeder-vengeance.text: Icon of Old Caliban: Friendly DARK ANGELS LIGHT and DARK ANGELS HEAVY units have the Stealth ability whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

stasis-bomb.name: Stasis Bomb
stasis-bomb.text: Once per battle, when this unit finishes making a Move action, select one enemy unit it moved over whilst making that Move action and roll three D6, adding 1 to the result if that unit is a CHARACTER and/or INFANTRY; for each result of 4+ place one blast marker next to that unit.

the-spiritshield-helm.name: The Spiritshield Helm
the-spiritshield-helm.text: Friendly DARK ANGELS units gain the Ignore Damage (6+) ability whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

intractable-will.name: Intractable Will
intractable-will.text: Morale tests taken for this unit are automatically passed.

inner-circle.name: Inner Circle
inner-circle.text: You can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made by this unit that target FALLEN units.

rites-of-battle.name: Rites of Battle
rites-of-battle.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly DARK ANGELS units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

tactical-precision.name: Tactical Precision
tactical-precision.text: Re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly DARK ANGELS units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

no-escape.name: No Escape
no-escape.text: Ravenwing units within 6" of this unit do not suffer the penalty for attacks made with ranged weapons that target obscured units.

narthecium.name: Narthecium
narthecium.text: At the end of the Action phase, this unit can attempt to heal one friendly DARK ANGELS LIGHT unit in base contact with it. If it does, roll one D6; on a 4+ remove one damage marker from that LIGHT unit. Only one attempt to heal each unit can be made each turn.

honour-or-death.name: Honour or Death
honour-or-death.text: You can re-roll wound rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by this unit that target CHARACTER units.

litanies-of-hate.name: Litanies of Hate
litanies-of-hate.text: You can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by friendly DARK ANGELS units whilst they are within 6" of this unit

spiritual-leader.name: Spiritual Leader
spiritual-leader.text: Friendly DARK ANGELS units can use this unit’s Leadership characteristic instead of their own whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

astartes-banner.name: Astartes Banner
astartes-banner.text: Morale tests taken for friendly DARK ANGELS units are automatically passed whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

command-squad-bodyguard.name: Command Squad Bodyguard
command-squad-bodyguard.text: At the start of the Damage phase, you can select one friendly DARK ANGELS LIGHT CHARACTER unit that has at least one blast marker next to it and is within 6" of this unit. Remove up to D3 blast markers from that CHARACTER unit and place them next to this unit.
